root_cause.text: The BPF subsystem did not enforce that a freplace (EXT) program's kprobe_write_ctx flag matches the target kprobe program's flag, allowing a freplace program with write permission to modify pt_regs of kernel functions through a kprobe that was not granted such permission.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that uprobe programs (which have kprobe_write_ctx=true) can be abused via freplace to modify registers of unrelated kernel functions, and the patch adds a check: "if (prog->type == BPF_PROG_TYPE_EXT && prog->aux->kprobe_write_ctx != tgt_prog->aux->kprobe_write_ctx)" to reject such attachments.
